title: Preserve eligible generated-artifact refresh request JSON

phases.objective: Keep the read-only generated-artifact PR request bridge structurally identical while ensuring the valid eligible path emits one parseable request object with reason=null instead of suppressing the entire jq result when the diagnostic reason is empty.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted default-branch generated-artifact PR request bridge
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Eligible open same-repository ready-for-review PR targeting main with exact head, governed work branch and generated-artifact-refresh label
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The request evaluator emits a non-empty mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-request.v1 JSON object with outcome=eligible and reason=null, allowing artifact upload and the independent dispatcher lifecycle to continue.
steps: Read the permanent request workflow and verify the eligible reason expression is null-safe rather than filter-based.
Execute the exact jq reason expression with an empty reason and representative exact-head request fields.
Parse the emitted JSON and verify contract, eligible outcome, null reason, exact head/ref identity and all no-mutation/no-secret flags.
assertions: An empty eligible reason never suppresses the complete request object.
Eligible requests encode reason as null and remain valid JSON.
Candidate checkout, repository mutation, protected-branch mutation, force push, job-log authority and secrets remain false.
No writer dispatch, repository content mutation, Production operation, SQL/Migration Apply, provider call or secret access is performed by this regression.
